title: Recruitment Manager
description:
About the group

We operate four businesses out of Bettiah: Alok Bharati Shikshan Sansthan (ABSS) — a CBSE\-affiliated K\-12 school; an LG\-authorised electronics showroom; and two hotels.

Role summary

The Recruitment Manager owns the full hiring funnel across all four businesses, with the school (ABSS) as the primary focus (roughly 60–70% of the role). You will build sourcing pipelines, run searches end\-to\-end, and become the person who can reliably bring in the right candidate for any open role across the group, on time and within budget.

Key responsibilities

* Work with the Principal, business heads, and the Owner to clarify what each open role actually needs — qualifications, experience, behaviours, must\-haves vs nice\-to\-haves — and convert that into a sharp JD.
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline for each business.
* Phone screens, written assessments where relevant (especially demo lessons for teachers), and shortlisting against role criteria.
* Run the interview process end\-to\-end — scheduling, briefing interviewers, preparing structured interview guides, collecting feedback, and keeping candidates warm through the process.
* For teaching roles, coordinate demo classes — finding a suitable class and date, briefing the candidate, organising observers, collecting evaluations.
* Always do them, including a phone call to the previous school or employer. Document outcomes.
* Prepare offer letters, negotiate within sanctioned bands, handle counter\-offers, and close. Manage the period between offer and joining actively — most no\-shows happen here.

Required qualifications and experience

* Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred
* 4–7 years in recruitment, with at least 2 years on school/teacher hiring strongly preferred
* Strong written and spoken English
* Comfortable using a computer and MS Office regularly; familiar with hiring platforms such as LinkedIn, Indeed, and Naukri.com

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

**Industry:** Medical Devices / Healthcare / Life Sciences Manufacturing

**About the Role**


We are looking for an experienced Compensation \& Benefits professional to join our client on an interim assignment for 6–8 months. This role will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end payroll governance, compensation operations, statutory compliance coordination, reporting, audits, and employee compensation support in partnership with an external payroll service provider and internal stakeholders.


The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in payroll operations, compensation administration, statutory processes, reporting, reconciliations, and financial accuracy, as well as the ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll \& Compensation Operations**

* Manage end\-to\-end payroll coordination with the third\-party payroll vendor.
* Validate monthly payroll inputs and ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
* Conduct payroll validation, salary variance analysis, and net pay variance checks.
* Perform final payroll audits and ensure payroll accuracy before salary disbursement.
* Manage bank transfer validation, transfer advice, and bank file uploads on banking portals.
* Coordinate payroll\-related statutory compliance payments and timelines.
* Support payroll processing for interns and consultants.
* Handle employee compensation and payroll\-related queries effectively.

**Compensation Administration**

* Prepare and manage offer letters and increment letters.
* Support salary revisions, compensation structures, and related documentation.
* Manage reimbursement payments and lease\-related payments.
* Prepare salary provisions and salary journal vouchers (JV).
* Coordinate salary JV entries in SAP.

**Reporting, Reconciliation \& Compliance**

* Prepare MIS reports for HR and leadership stakeholders.
* Conduct monthly headcount reconciliations.
* Support quarterly activities including:


	+ Inventory loading data
	+ Audit schedules
	+ Cross\-charge reconciliations
	+ Gratuity valuation
	+ Leave provision calculations
* Support annual operating planning (AOP) activities related to compensation and manpower budgeting.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness, and process compliance.

**Key Requirements**

* 8–15\+ years of experience in Compensation \& Benefits, Payroll Operations, or HR Shared Services.
* Strong expertise in payroll governance and vendor\-managed payroll environments.
* Experience handling payroll audits, reconciliations, salary variances, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Hands\-on exposure to SAP and payroll systems.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in an individual contributor setup.
* High attention to detail and strong process orientation.
* Prior experience in manufacturing, healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical devices, or similar regulated industries will be preferred.

title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst
description:
Job title: Workday Data Migration, Conversion and Mapping Analyst


Job location: Hyderabad, Hub


Job type: Fulltime/Permanent


About Sanofi


At Sanofi, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As a global healthcare leader, we are committed to transforming the practice of medicine by pursuing breakthrough science, building sustainable business models, and expanding access to our medicines and vaccines. Our people are at the heart of everything we do — and so is the data that powers our operations.

**About the job**


The Opportunity


This is an exciting opportunity to further develop your career in data migration and Workday by joining a newly created Data Migration team at a pivotal moment. With 80% involvement in complex global projects — including implementations, data migrations, reporting and visualization initiatives, data sharing agreements, and data foundation developments — this role will support mission\-critical data mapping and loading activities that directly impact business operations, M\&A success, and compliance.


You will work under the Data Migration and Conversion Lead and have an expertise in Workday and EiB loads.


Key Responsibilities


Data Mapping Support

* Assist in building and maintaining source\-to\-Workday field mappings for loads
* Support documentation of transformation logic, validation rules, and value conversions
* Learn and apply country\-specific data standardization approaches
* Support mapping activities under the guidance of senior analysts


Bulk Load Execution Support

* Assist in executing Workday bulk loads using EIB and approved tools
* Support design and validation of templates, sequencing, and dependencies
* Prepare loads for review by senior analysts
* Follow approved governance processes and standards at all times


Migration Delivery Support

* Support end\-to\-end migration execution including mock loads, reconciliations, and production loads
* Assist in maintaining migration playbooks and cutover plans
* Support test load execution and result validation
* Assist in reconciliations between source and target systems


M\&A Support

* Assist in assessing and mapping incoming HR data for acquisitions
* Support cleansing, transformation, and loading activities for acquired populations
* Support data extraction and separation activities for divestitures
* Contribute to Day 1 readiness preparation for employee data in Workday


Data Quality Assurance

* Perform basic pre\-load data quality checks
* Identify and escalate data quality issues to senior analysts
* Support Data Governance and Data Quality teams on remediation activities
* Assist in guarding the People Data Model via correct data preparation


Documentation \& Audit Support

* Assist in maintaining audit trails, reconciliation reports, and rollback procedures
* Support load documentation maintenance and compliance
* Assist with audit and compliance requirements

**About you**


Required Qualifications

* Education \& Experience: Bachelor's degree in information systems, Data Management, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field
* 2\-5 years of experience in data management, data analysis, or related roles
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Workday EiB and HCM Certified
* Experience working in team environments


Technical Skills

* Strong Python, Excel and data automation and manipulation skills required
* Worked with Informatica or other ETL tools
* Basic SQL knowledge would be beneficial
* Workday HCM knowledge and EiB load preparation and execution
* Understanding of data concepts and data quality principles
* Comfortable learning new technical tools and systems


Soft Skills \& Behaviours

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong communication and documentation skills
* Ability to follow processes and procedures consistently
* Proactive approach to learning and professional development
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Collaborative mindset with willingness to support team members


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with data analysis or data quality and conversio tools
* Strong understanding of Workday and EiB Loads
* Workday Certification: EiB Manager and HCM
* Knowledge of data governance principles
* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry
* Familiarity with process documentation and standard operating procedures
* Exposure to project management or Agile methodologies


What Success Looks Like

* Accurate completion of assigned data mapping and load preparation tasks
* Successful support of bulk load execution with minimal errors in Workday
* Consistent adherence to data quality standards and governance processes
* Timely completion of assigned migration activities within project timelines
* Accurate and complete documentation of all work performed
* Proactive identification and escalation of data quality issues
* Strong collaboration with other analysts and team members
* Continuous learning and skill development in Workday and data migration
* Meaningful contribution to successful M\&A integrations and data migrations


Why Join Sanofi?

* **Join a newly created team** with significant impact on global operations from day one

title: Senior Associate - Talent Panning
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-244890 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: May. 14, 2026 CATEGORY: Human Resources
**Job Description**


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will support hiring plan maintenance and help drive talent planning services across geographies. You will actively partner with HRBPs, Workforce Planning, and Talent Acquisition teams to enable timely recruitment activation for the right roles at the right time.

**Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a consolidated hiring plan dataset, including records management and the development of rolling global workforce plans.
* Reconcile and report hiring plan data, and communicate planned vs. actual requisition status to Hiring Managers and HR Business Partners.
* Support the rollout of a continuous recruitment process and related enhancements to hiring plan administration workflows.
* Partner with the analytics lead to ensure hiring plan data supports recruitment process dashboards.
* Lead data reconciliation with Organizational Design and Talent Acquisition teams to ensure hiring plan data aligns with organizational design plans of record and TA activity.
* Partner with hiring leads to provide hiring process guidance, support required actions, and serve as a point of contact for issue resolution and key deliverables.
* Support analytics dashboard and source data refinement while maintaining reports and dashboards for organizational design workflows.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Collaborate with team members and support ongoing process improvements as needed.

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 7\+ years of experience in Talent Planning, Workforce Planning, HR Operations, Recruitment Operations, or a related HR function


OR

* Master’s degree and 6\+ years of relevant experience
* Experience supporting hiring plan management, workforce data reconciliation, reporting, and recruitment coordination.
* Experience partnering with HRBPs, Workforce Planning, Talent Acquisition, and cross\-functional stakeholders in a global environment.
* Strong project coordination, stakeholder management, data accuracy, and analytical skills.

**Must\-Have Skills:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and HR/workforce planning tools.
* Experience in hiring plan management, reporting, and data reconciliation.
* Understanding of workforce planning, recruitment operations, and organizational design workflows.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong attention to detail and process orientation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Sound judgment when handling confidential data.
* Agile mindset and continuous learning orientation.

**What you can expect of us**


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

description:
**Job Title:** **Assistant HR IT Manager \- Global Mobility**

**Location: Bangalore**

**ABOUT UNILEVER:**


Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose\-led business. Work with brands that are well\-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.


Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.

**ABOUT BANGALORE HUB:**


Bangalore Hub is the global technology and operations engine of Unilever offering business services, technology, and enterprise solutions. Bangalore Hub serves over 190 locations and through a network of specialized service lines and partners delivers insights and innovations, user experiences and end\-to\-end seamless delivery making Unilever Purpose Led and Future Fit.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-oriented Global Mobility Technology partner to join our team and play a key role in transforming our Global mobility processes into digital solutions. You will work closely with the HR, PEX teams at our global locations to understand their needs and challenges and then collaborate with the technology teams within HR IT and broader Unilever IT to design and implement innovative digital solutions that streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.


This role will be responsible for the overall administration of Global mobility technology platform(s) for international assignees and expat payroll, managing enterprise\-wide design framework, implementation of updates brought about by periodic releases and changes required by the users in the Equus AssignmentPro or other Global mobility systems.


This also includes maintaining standards, impact assessment and solution recommendation. The HR IT business partner for Global mobility serves as Subject Matter Expert on Equus AssignmentPro and will provide support to any related modules and downstream systems.

**WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE**

* First point of contact for Global and regional HR team and UL vendors for new demands, change request or any support requirement for Global Mobility
* Setting up, configuring, and maintaining all objects related to Global Mobility in AssignmentPro. Establishing and maintaining tenant wide standards on managing objects related to global mobility.
* Ensures accuracy of global mobility setup to sustain integrity of Equus AssignmentPro as single source of truth system and support sustenance of data flow to other linked platforms
* Captures, reviews \& act upon, including testing \& assessing impact of periodic releases related to global mobility technologies
* Liaises with Global Process Owners on change impact
* Sets key performance indicators of the team and ensures that key responsibility areas are managed efficiently and excellently
* Actively works and supports resolution of issues escalated, managing incidents, tracking ticket status and partnering with support teams to resolve
* Identifies and recommends processes areas that could be simplified, improved or changed; to enhance user experience and drive simplification
* Provides support in maintaining training activities and materials, including user guides, FAQ, recorded demos, portal content, etc.
* Plans projects that address business needs, and assess fit of new global mobility applications and vendors
* Support all global mobility integrations for any new demand, change request or trouble shooting
* Impact Assessment on payroll and rewards for any changes in AssignmentPro or any related application
* Liaises between HR and IT teams and supports HR business during project and BAU
* Ensures requirements and test plans are signed off in projects
* Ensures requirements by HR and IT are understood by both parties before any change or project
* Takes up IT project management role if there is no dedicated project manager in projects
* Works with HR team for user acceptance testing and ensure stakeholders are ready for go\-live
* Works on various KRAs for global mobility programs
* Assess global mobility processes and suggests automation opportunities
* Ensures that new vendors meet local and global Unilever standards and strategy.
* Supports business in vendor transitions.
* Implements new global mobility integration projects between global mobility technology platforms such as AssignmentPro and various systems such as Workday and Payroll systems
* Works with Data Privacy Team, Vendor Risk Management team and Cybersecurity team to ensure that new projects meet company standards
* Works with Enterprise Architecture to ensure that new projects are aligned with global technology strategy

**EXPERIENCES \& QUALIFICATIONS**

*Necessary Experience \& Qualifications*

* Education: A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Experience: 7\+ years of overall experience in HR technologies
* Technical Skills: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Equus AssignmentPro. Payroll experience is good to have.
* Project Management: Project management experience, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

*Preferred Experience \& Qualifications*

* Project Management: Experience managing timelines, deliverables, and coordinating multiple work streams is beneficial.
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience working in agile environments.
* Knowledge of AssignmentPro and other HR systems in the domain of Global Mobility and payroll
* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end Global Mobility HR processes, payroll, compensation and benefits and ability to define dependencies and connect the dots across the technology landscape.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Outstanding analytical, problem solving and fact\-finding skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate solution design, design proposals and negotiate options with stakeholders
* Ability to understand the HR’s business problem, need, or opportunity and to design a solution that completely and correctly addresses the need.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to identify, clarify and resolve project issues and risks as needed.
* Strong relationship building skills to effectively partner with HR CoEs and other internal teams and external vendors.
* Ability to manage time and resources efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work independently.

**SKILLS**

* Equus Assignment Pro
* International Assignments
* Expat Payroll
* Change Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Collaboration
* Customer Centricity
* Data Driven Decision making
* Digital Technology awareness
* Product Delivery
* Project Management

**LEADERSHIP SKILLS**

* **Unilever Behaviors** \[highlight the 2 most important for this role]


	+ **PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE:** Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
	+ **PERSONAL MASTERY:** Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
	+ **TALENT CATALYST:** Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best. Inspires powerful teamwork and collaboration, connecting people for better results.
	+ **CONSUMER LOVE:** Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
	+ **BUSINESS ACUMEN**: Creates opportunities for profitable growth through the core and beyond.


At HUL, we believe that every individual irrespective of their race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, nationality, caste, disability or marital status can bring their purpose to life. So apply to us, to unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make the world a better place. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you!

description:
**Job Title:** Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Job Type:** Permanent, Full Time


**Remote Working:** Hybrid

 **Our Team**


We're an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

 **About the Job**


As Strategic Workforce Planning Analyst within our People Insights \& AI team, you'll play a critical role in shaping how Sanofi plans its workforce future. Reporting to People Insights Partnership Leader, you'll work closely with our Strategic Workforce Planning (SWP) team on day\-to\-day delivery — building scenarios, optimizing Visier Planning, and producing cross\-functional insights that drive smarter decisions. This is a specialist role based in Hyderabad, focused on driving workforce insights across 7 Organizational Developments (ODs) while building capability in business users to become self\-sufficient. Over time, you'll also have the opportunity to partner with our Data Science \& AI team to sharpen and automate workforce analytics.

 **Main Responsibilities**

* Build, validate, and iterate workforce scenarios across 7 Organizational Developments to inform short\-term Operational Workforce Planning and Strategic (SWP)Workforce Planning decisions, turning complex cross\-Organizational Development data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders
* Drive Visier Planning improvements and optimization — not just operating the platform, but actively enhancing it to deliver better insights and efficiency
* Apply SWP methodology consistently across the organization, including scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and workforce cost modeling
* Enable ODs and People Business Partners to become self\-sufficient in Visier Planning and SWP, building lasting capability rather than reliance on the SWP team
* Collaborate with the People Insights Partner team across COE topics (skills, talent, D\&I, compensation, and more) ensuring workforce planning is connected to and reinforces broader people strategy
* Partner with the Data Science \& AI team and SWP leads to identify opportunities to sharpen or automate workforce analytics, contributing to continuous innovation

**About You**

**Experience:**

* Demonstrated expertise in strategic workforce planning and people analytics, with proven ability to translate complex HR data into actionable business insights that drive organizational strategy.
* Hands\-on experience in emerging platforms— focused on Visier improvement and optimization beyond day\-to\-day use
* Demonstrated ability to train and enable business users — comfortable upskilling others, not just producing analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong scenario modeling skills: workforce cost modeling, headcount planning, and sensitivity analysis
* Proficiency in data visualization and storytelling to translate complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights
* Familiarity with emerging technologies and AI\-enabled analytics platforms

**Education:**

* Degree in Human Resources, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)


**Soft Skills:**

* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including with global and cross\-functional teams
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across organizational boundaries
* Curiosity and drive to continuously improve tools, processes, and analytical frameworks

**Languages:**

* Fluent English (written and spoken) required

**Why Choose Us**

* Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life\-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet
* Work at the intersection of workforce strategy and cutting\-edge analytics — using Visier Planning to shape how a global biopharma company plans its talent future
* Drive Progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably
* Build real capability across the organization — your work won't just produce insights, it will empower teams to think and act more strategically about their workforce
* Grow into data science — this role offers a genuine long\-term trajectory toward workforce data science and advanced analytics, with active support from the team
* Advance your career through stretch roles, cross\-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition
* Thrive in inclusive, high\-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what's next

title: HR Operations Analyst
description:
Netgear is looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end people operations for our India offices. This role is central to delivering a seamless employee experience \- spanning onboarding and offboarding, payroll and benefits administration, employee relations, statutory compliance, and general administrative oversight. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a high\-ownership environment, is comfortable working across functions and geographies, and brings a structured approach to managing multiple operational priorities simultaneously. This is an individual contributor role with broad organizational impact, requiring strong cross\-functional coordination with Finance, Legal, IT, and global HR teams.


This is a hybrid role that requires in office attendance 3 days a week in either Bangalore or Chennai.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Onboarding \& Offboarding**

* Coordinate pre\-boarding documentation including ID proofs, educational certificates, and background verification data.
* Set up new employees in HRIS across India and global systems, ensuring data accuracy and timely completion.
* Facilitate HR onboarding sessions for new joiners, covering employee benefits, policies, and key HR processes.
* Conduct HR orientation sessions covering benefits briefings, policy walkthroughs, and compliance training for all new joiners.
* Manage end\-to\-end resignation workflows including exit interviews, experience letters, and relieving formalities.
* Provide timely inputs for background verification requests related to ex\-employees.

**Payroll \& Benefits Administration**

* Collect and validate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leave records, pay changes, and loss\-of\-pay deductions.
* Coordinate with Finance and payroll vendors to ensure accurate and timely salary processing each cycle.
* Manage employee insurance administration, including handling queries, coordinating with vendors, and processing monthly additions and deletions.
* Maintain statutory registers and support statutory filings including PF, PT, and Shops \& Establishment compliance.
* Liaise with labour law consultants on audits, inspections, and compliance updates.
* Oversee POSH compliance including Internal Committee (IC) constitution, employee awareness training, and annual reporting.

**Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Manage leave and attendance systems and maintain up\-to\-date holiday calendars for all India offices.
* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee queries on policies, payroll, benefits, and general HR processes.
* Issue employment\-related letters including salary certificates, employment verification letters, and visa support documentation.

**General Administration Support**

* Manage India\-specific HR and administrative vendors including background verification agencies, insurance brokers, payroll providers, and facilities partners.
* Track and maintain vendor service agreements, renewal timelines, and performance metrics.
* Plan and execute company events, training logistics, employee welfare programs, and engagement activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 4–8 years of experience in HR operations, with strong exposure to payroll administration, statutory compliance, and employee lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and payroll software used in India\-based operations.
* Solid understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements including PF, PT, Shops \& Establishment, and POSH.
* Proven ability to manage vendor relationships and track service agreements across multiple functions.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high\-volume, deadline\-driven payroll and compliance processes.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work effectively across employee levels, functions, and geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, and drive outcomes independently.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, and familiarity with HRIS/HRMS tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a multinational or technology company, coordinating with global HR teams.
* Prior exposure to managing India\-specific benefits renewals and insurance broker relationships.
* Experience supporting or leading POSH Internal Committee (IC) processes.
* Background in supporting facility operations or office administration alongside core HR responsibilities.

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

 SBI Card is proud to be an equal opportunity \& inclusive employer and welcome employees without any discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, gender, religion, creed, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, caste etc. SBI Card is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are treated equally with dignity and respect which makes it a promising place to work.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of digital payment in India and unlock your full potential.
   

  

**What’s In It For YOU**
* SBI Card truly lives by the work\-life balance philosophy. We offer a robust wellness and wellbeing program to support mental and physical health of our employees
* Admirable work deserves to be rewarded. We have a well curated bouquet of rewards and recognition program for the employees
* Dynamic, Inclusive and Diverse team culture
* Gender Neutral Policy
* Inclusive Health Benefits for all \- Medical Insurance, Personal Accidental, Group Term Life Insurance and Annual Health Checkup, Dental and OPD benefits
* Commitment to the overall development of an employee through comprehensive learning \& development framework


**Role Purpose**
 Ensure the effective design, delivery, and evaluation of training programs that enhance employee skills, knowledge, and performance.
   

  

**Role Accountability**
* Program Development and Implementation: Design and implement training programs that align with organizational goals and address skill gaps
* Facilitation and Delivery: Conduct training sessions \& workshops ensuring they are engaging and effective
* Assessment and Evaluation: Develop and administer assessments to measure the effectiveness of training programs and the retention of knowledge
* Continuous Improvement: Regularly review and update training materials and methods to ensure they remain relevant and effective
* Employee Development: Support employees in their professional growth by identifying development needs and providing appropriate learning opportunities.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to ensure training programs meet the needs of the organization and its employees
* Resource Management: Manage training resources, including budgets, materials, and external partnerships, to ensure efficient program delivery
* Reporting and Analysis: Track and report on training metrics, such as completion rates and knowledge retention, to demonstrate the impact of training initiatives
* Support and Guidance: Provide ongoing support and guidance to employees, helping them apply new skills and knowledge in their roles
* Compliance and Standards: Ensure all training programs comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements


**Measures of Success**
* Training Attendance Rate: The percentage of employees who attend scheduled training sessions
* Course Completion Rate: The percentage of employees who complete the training programs they start
* Average Time to Completion: The average time it takes for employees to complete training programs
* Post\-Training Assessment Results: Scores from assessments conducted after training to measure knowledge retention and understanding
* Learner Satisfaction Rate: Feedback from employees on their satisfaction with the training programs, often gathered through surveys
* Learner Retention Rate: The percentage of knowledge and skills retained by employees over a specified period after training
* Job Performance Impact: The improvement in job performance metrics, such as productivity or quality of work, following training
* Training ROI (Return on Investment): The financial return generated from training investments, calculated by comparing the cost of training to the benefits gained
* Reduction in Skill Gaps: The decrease in identified skill gaps within the organization as a result of targeted training initiatives
* Training Program Quality: Regular evaluation of training content and delivery methods to ensure they meet high standards

Submit service reports to the HOD and respective internal sales personnel for claim processing. Knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, and industrial automation systems.

title: Business Analyst - AI
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.** 




  





 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organizations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



  





 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The team** 




  





 You’ll partner with Enabling Area / AI Team to unlock value from data and AI through modern analytics and GenAI capabilities (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations) and strong delivery practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 • Lead stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs to elicit and document functional/non\-functional requirements (BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
 



 • Perform gap analysis, feasibility assessments, and traceability from business goals to product features.
 



 • Shape product vision and roadmap for AI features; prioritize backlogs based on value, feasibility, and risk.
 



 • Run Agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint planning, reviews) and maintain clear release plans and OKRs.
 



 • Translate use cases into LLM/GenAI solutions (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation criteria) with DS/ML engineers.
 



 • Coordinate data availability, model monitoring, and governance (security, privacy, cost/performance) with platform teams.
 



 • Demo increments, validate requirements, and manage UAT with business users; drive adoption and training assets (playbooks, guides).
 



 • Communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership; support post\-launch analysis and continuous improvement.
 



 • Maintain clear artefacts (journey maps, process flows, personas, wireframes) and QA/test plans in partnership with QA leads.
 



  





**Qualifications**




 • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business; MBA is a plus.
 



 • Experience: Typically, 3–5 years in Product/BA roles.
 



 • Core: Proven requirements management, backlog ownership, and Agile delivery with enterprise stakeholders.
 



  





**Skills (Must\-have)**




 • Strong BA toolkit (elicitation, analysis, documentation, UAT).
 



 • Product tools (Jira/ADO/Confluence), and proficiency in MS Office for analysis and communication.
 



 • AI literacy: familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts, RAG patterns, evaluation/guardrails, and data governance.
 



 • Collaboration across Data Science, Engineering, UX; excellent stakeholder communication.
 



  





**Preferred Exposure**




 • Hands\-on with prompt design, GenAI evaluation, vector databases, or model lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring).
 



 • Experience in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data/ML tooling.
 



  





**Success Metrics (KPIs)**




 • Requirement lead time (from intake to signed\-off user stories), backlog health, and sprint goal attainment.
 



 • Feature adoption (usage, satisfaction), model performance \& cost (for AI features), and defect escape rate/UAT pass\-rate.
 



  





**Working Model**




 Hybrid, with flexibility for stakeholder workshops, demos, and UAT at office/client sites as needed.
 



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





***Connect for impact***




  





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.
 








***Empower to lead***




  





 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.
 








***Inclusion for all***




  





 At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



  





***Drive your career***




  





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.
 



  





**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us** 




  





 Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.
 



  





**Interview tips** 




  





 We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident and comfortable. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research, know some background about the organisation and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
   

  

**About the role :**
 As a Business Analyst in the Donor Information System (DIS) space within the Plasma\-Derived Therapies (PDT) business unit, you will independently serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. You will collaborate closely with multiple stakeholders, determine requirements, translate business needs into effective technical solutions, maintaining continuous dialogue with all teams to ensure robustness, accuracy and consistency.
   

  

 By gathering requirements and facilitating cross\-team communication between business and IT teams, this role directly contributes to PDT’s ability to harness data effectively, enhancing decision\-making capabilities, and ultimately, competitive advantage in the market. You will be adopting cutting\-edge technologies and methodologies which will help Takeda drive innovation, adapt to new opportunities, and continuously evolve in an ever\-changing business/technological landscape.
   

  

 This position will align to Functional Analysis chapter of the ICC and initially report to the Functional Delivery Lead for strategic direction as well as day\-to\-day management until the role of BA Lead is filled within Takeda ICC, post which the reporting and managerial responsibilities will be transitioned accordingly.
   

  

**How you will contribute :**
* Contribute to the execution team by proactively clarifying requirements, identifying gaps, and escalating risks.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Senior Business Analysts and product stakeholders to ensure functional expectations are understood and delivered.
* Act as a reliable communication link between developers, testers, Quality, and business SMEs.
* Lead requirement‑gathering discussions for low–to–moderately complex features, including understanding user needs, non‑functional requirements, and pain points.
* Analyze requirements and document them into clear, structured artifacts such as Epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.

* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, and story grooming sessions

* Conduct gap analysis, process mapping, and impact assessments for new enhancements.
* Support and contribute to user acceptance testing (UAT) efforts, including test case development, test execution, issue resolution, and assist in triaging functional defects.

* Understand the business justification for the product, client’s vision, and future scope.
* Create functional design documents and other documentation required as part of GxP documentation process and work closely with the Quality and Validation teams ensuring timely approvals are obtained.
* Ensure documentation remains audit‑ready, consistent, and aligned with development and Quality expectations.
* Maintain Confluence spaces with updated feature details, design notes, and process artifacts.

title: HR Associate
description:
**HR Associates\- Roles \& Responsibilities** 

An HR Operations job role typically involves managing and overseeing the operational aspects of human resources within an organization. This role focuses on streamlining HR processes, ensuring compliance with regulations, maintaining employee records, and supporting various HR functions to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations. Here are the key responsibilities and tasks associated with an HR Operations role:

Key Responsibilities:

* **Employee Records Management:**
* Ensure accurate and up\-to\-date employee records.
* Manage the documentation of new hires, promotions, transfers, and exits.
* Maintain and update employee files, both physical and digital.
* **Onboarding and Offboarding:**
* Oversee the process of onboarding new employees, ensuring all paperwork, training, and introductions are handled properly.
* Manage offboarding processes when employees leave, including exit interviews, final settlements, and returning company property.
* **HR Systems Management:**
* Manage HR software systems (HRIS) and tools used for tracking employee data, performance, and compliance.
* Ensure accurate and efficient use of systems to streamline HR processes like payroll, benefits, and attendance.
* **Payroll and Benefits Administration:**
* Assist with payroll processing, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
* Administer employee benefits programs, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and other perks.
* **Compliance and Reporting:**
* Ensure adherence to labor laws, company policies, and industry regulations.
* Prepare and submit compliance reports, such as government filings and audits.
* Keep track of employees’ work hours, vacation time, and sick leave to ensure compliance with regulations.
* **Employee Relations:**
* Act as a point of contact for employees regarding HR\-related queries or issues.
* Resolve conflicts or concerns within the team in collaboration with HR Business Partners or managers.
* **HR Policy Implementation:**
* Ensure HR policies and procedures are implemented consistently across the organization.
* Monitor adherence to policies and provide feedback or suggestions for improvements.

**1\) Job Purpose:** ***Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)*** **(Max 1325 Characters)**
===============================================================================================================

  

To manage the collections process at a Regional level, build and manage a best\-in\-class high efficiency Collections Team to enable delivery of ECL \& NCL parameters. livery of ECL \& NCL parameters and to liaise with in\-house and external collections teams and to oversee their activities, ensuring compliance with all internal policies and relevant regulations.

 **2\) Dimensions:** Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.

  

Other Quantitative and Important Parameters for the job

  

* Digital Book is a small ticket higher bounce rate book on account of the construct of the segment and borrower profile
* ECL Management – Stage 1 and Stage 2 (feeder for Stage 3\) Provisions to be managed by the incumbent for entire Zone.
* Strong vintage in handling the zone /region in debt management.
* Ability to conceptualize and effectively execute the various collections strategies with focus on Small Ticket Collections
**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ((Max 3975 Characters)**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

  

Organization Context


Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.

  

ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABFL also has a Wealth Management division.

  

ABFL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABFL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.

  

Job Context


Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.

  

The Small ticket segment comprises primarily Digitally sourced accounts with ticket sizes ranging 10k – 5 lacs. This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective zone.

  

The incumbent will be accountable for field collections for the customers in the region. For this segment, the collections model would primarily be an Agency Model for flows. The incumbent needs to have a strong understanding of small ticket business and challenges on the debt\-management process.

**4\) Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\-** **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (****Max 1325 Characters)**

  

Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

 **ECL Management \& Costs**

  

* Monitor and Control delinquency and minimize ECL for portfolio
* Drive higher resolution rates resulting in reduced ECL
* Review, maintain control and Optimize the cost incurred towards collections of dues.
* Daily monitoring and regular reviews of delinquent portfolio
 **Portfolio review and monitoring**

  

* Monitor location level and sub\-product level portfolios – location level and at various product level within the Digital Portfolio.
* Work with non\-performing defaulting borrowers to create optimum recovery solutions
* Developing various MISs to show different cuts and trends in the portfolio which can lead to necessary corrective action by collections team to enhance their performance and shows area of improvement.
* Provide regular inputs to Management and all the other stakeholders such as Sales, Risk, Policy Team on various aspects of collections resolution and delinquency trends, Negative Areas, Negative Profile, Non\-Starters, SKIPs, Fraud Cases, etc.
* Ensure good grip and control on the delinquent portfolio.
 **Vendor Management**

  

* Liaise with agencies to drive collections processes efficiently.
* Oversee selection processes for external agencies
* Continuously monitor agency performance against set parameters and targets
* Exercise adequate control on agencies to ensure collection of overdue debts in a timely manner
 **Compliance and audit**

  

* Ensure that all documentation related to the collections process is maintained in accordance with internal norms and regulatory requirements
* Respond to customer complaints regarding the collections process, taking steps to ensure a satisfactory outcome for both ABFL as well as its customers
* Plan and implement periodic audits of the collections teams, ensuring their compliance with all relevant policies and regulations
 **Customer escalations and complaints**

  

* Coordinate with the legal team and senior management in the event of escalated cases to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
 **People Management**

  

* Provide oversight and be a coach and mentor for the team
* Ensure regular functional \& behavioral trainings of team members in collaboration with HR
* Participate in relevant talent management and people development activities to ensure a healthy pipeline and an engaged team
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports: Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)**
=================================================================================================================================

 **Collections Manager**: To manage the collections process at a location level (usually a Metro or State Capital) or few Tier 2\-3 cities, working with non\-performing defaulting borrowers to create optimum recovery solutions. To liaise with in\-house and external collections teams and to oversee their activities, ensuring compliance with all internal policies and relevant regulations.

title: Associate, HR (Global Mobility & Benefits)
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to **fueling decisions with expert insights**. We accelerate and enhance decision\-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.



For nearly 20 years, we've helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in\-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.



**Position Overview**



The HR Associate will be a member of the HR Operations team within our People Operations organisation, located in our Mumbai office. This position will be responsible for HR administrative support for all regions, as well as being the first line of contact for Mumbai employees.


To be successful in this role you'll be a self\-starter with the ability to work autonomously as well as collaborate with other team members. You will need to be extremely detail\-oriented, respond with a sense of urgency, and have strong time management and communication skills.



Please note that the working hours are Monday \- Friday, **from 11am \- 8pm Mumbai local time** with some flexibility in start and end times.


**Benefits Administration**


* Oversee day\-to\-day global benefits administration, ensuring timely resolution of employee queries and issues within agreed service levels.
* Assist with global benefits implementation, renewal processes and audits where needed.
* Respond to our employee inquiries and changes through our HR ticketing system and make any necessary changes in our systems and with our vendors.


**Mobility \& Visas**


* Support global mobility processes, including visa applications, renewals, and right\-to\-work documentation.
* Partner with immigration counsel and vendors to manage cases and ensure compliance with local regulations.
* Track visa expirations and work authorisation status to reduce compliance risks.
* Coordinate visa and work permit applications across multiple countries, including new applications, renewals, transfers, and dependent cases
* Act as a key point of contact for employees throughout immigration processes, providing guidance on required documentation and timelines
* Collect, review, and organise supporting documentation required for immigration submissions
* Track case progress and follow up proactively to ensure timelines are met
* Maintain accurate immigration trackers and records, including visa expiry dates and renewal schedules
* Ensure documentation is stored accurately and confidentially in line with internal requirements


**Data and Report Support**


* Maintain accurate, compliant, and confidential employee data in HRIS through data entry and audits.


**Other Administrative duties (but not limited to):**


* Support the invoicing process by partnering closely with finance
* Approve and upload employee photos in our HR system
* Data entry and data auditing


**Qualifications**



* Undergraduate degree with 2\+ years of experience within HR.
* Experience working in a global organisation and supporting human resources responsibilities across different geographies.
* Demonstrable knowledge of local employment laws and an understanding of HR practices and processes.
* Experience working with global mobility and visas is a plus.
* Excellent attention to detail and communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel)
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Self starter and ability to work independently


**Additional information**



**What can you expect**


* Flexible working
* Competitive salary
* Medical insurance \- include spouse and children
* Employee Provident Fund
* Personal annual learning and development budget
* 2 days' off per year for Community/Corporate Social Responsibility activity
* Hybrid work options available
* Occasional extended hours during peak HR cycles (open enrollment, audits, etc)


The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying

title: Intern
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**


We’re looking for people who:

* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description:**

**Join Pitney Bowes as QA Intern**
----------------------------------

**Years of Experience: 0\-2 years**
-----------------------------------

**Job Location\- Noida**
------------------------

**Impact**


As a QA Intern, you will contribute to ensuring the quality and reliability of our web and mobile (Android/iOS) applications. You will work alongside experienced QA engineers and developers to test features, identify defects, and improve overall product quality.


This internship is designed to provide hands\-on experience in manual testing, mobile app testing, and test automation, helping you build a strong foundation for a career in software quality engineering.

**The Job**

* Assist in testing web and mobile applications (Android/iOS) for functionality, usability, and performance.
* Write and execute test cases, test scenarios, and checklists based on product requirements.
* Perform manual testing including functional, regression, exploratory, and UI testing.
* Conduct mobile app testing including installation, upgrade, device compatibility, screen resolution, and OS version validation.
* Identify, log, and track bugs using tools like JIRA and ensure proper documentation.
* Validate REST APIs using tools like Postman.
* Learn and contribute to automation testing using tools like Selenium (web) and Appium (mobile).
* Test applications on real devices and cloud platforms like BrowserStack.
* Assist in smoke testing and build verification during releases.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies like daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Document test execution results and provide feedback to improve product quality.
* Learn industry best practices in QA, automation, and CI/CD workflows.

**Qualifications \& Skills Required**


This role is ideal for candidates starting their QA career (0–6 months experience or freshers):

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Basic understanding of software testing concepts (STLC, defect lifecycle).
* Familiarity with web applications and mobile apps (Android/iOS).
* Basic understanding of mobile app behavior and UI/UX principles.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Understanding of API testing basics.
* Exposure to tools like JIRA or any bug tracking tool is a plus.
* Basic programming knowledge (Java/Python/JavaScript) is a plus.
* Interest in learning automation tools like Selenium, Appium, or Cypress.
* Familiarity with Android Studio / Xcode simulators is a plus.
* Exposure to Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics) or similar tools is an added advantage.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and willingness to learn.

**The Team**

**Pitney Bowes** (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500\. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.

**We will:**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(****P****B Live Well**)


Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.

This internship is designed to provide hands\-on experience in manual testing, mobile app testing, and test automation, helping you build a strong foundation for a career in software quality engineering.

* Learn industry best practices in QA, automation, and CI/CD workflows.

For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com .

About Reasonify Technology

Reasonify Technology Private Limited is an Ahmedabad\-based AI products company building intelligent solutions across the Education, Sports, and ERP domains. Our flagship product line develops interactive, curriculum\-aligned educational tools for Indian schools (NCERT/CBSE), delivered through a proprietary AI\-powered platform. We are a fast\-growing, founder\-led startup where every team member makes a meaningful impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Generalist to be the backbone of our people function. This is a hands\-on, end\-to\-end HR role covering the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding and payroll to performance appraisals, compliance, and learning \& development. You will work closely with the leadership team to build HR systems that scale with the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Payroll \& Compensation Management

▸Process monthly payroll accurately and on schedule for all employees and interns

▸Manage salary structures, increments, arrears, deductions, and full \& final settlements

▸Maintain payroll records and generate payslips via payroll software (e.g., Keka, GreytHR, or equivalent)

▸Co\-ordinate with the Finance team for disbursements and expense reimbursements

2\. Stipend Management

▸Administer stipend disbursements for interns and contractual contributors

▸Maintain stipend agreements, offer letters, and timely renewal documentation

▸Track joining / exit of interns and ensure proper onboarding \& offboarding

3\. Performance Appraisals \& Goal Management

▸Design and execute the annual and mid\-year appraisal cycles

▸Facilitate goal\-setting (OKRs / KRAs) in collaboration with team leads and directors

▸Maintain appraisal records, calibration notes, and increment recommendation sheets

▸Drive a culture of continuous feedback and recognition

4\. Training \& Learning Development

▸Identify training needs through skill gap analysis and manager inputs

▸Organise and co\-ordinate internal workshops, external certifications, and e\-learning programmes

▸Maintain training calendars, budgets, attendance records, and feedback reports

▸Evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions and iterate accordingly

5\. Statutory \& Legal Compliance

▸Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws and statutory requirements:

–Provident Fund (PF) — registration, challan filing, ECR submissions

–Employee State Insurance (ESI) — enrolment, contributions, claim support

–Professional Tax (PT) — monthly deduction and remittance

–TDS on Salary (Form 24Q) — co\-ordination with CA / Finance

–Gratuity, Bonus Act, Shops \& Establishment Act — record\-keeping and compliance

▸Liaise with PF/ESI portals, company CA, and labour departments as required

▸Keep employee documentation current — contracts, NDAs, appointment letters, etc.

▸Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure zero statutory penalties

6\. Recruitment \& Onboarding

▸Manage end\-to\-end hiring for full\-time, contract, and internship positions

▸Source candidates via job portals (LinkedIn, Naukri, Internshala), campus connects, and referrals

▸Conduct HR screening rounds, co\-ordinate technical interviews, and manage offer rollouts

▸Execute structured onboarding — induction, system access, buddy assignment, 30\-60\-90 day check\-ins

7\. Employee Relations \& HR Operations

▸Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries on HR policies, leave, benefits, and conduct

▸Maintain accurate HRMS records — attendance, leave balances, personal files

▸Handle grievance redressal in a fair, confidential, and timely manner

▸Drive employee engagement initiatives — team events, surveys, feedback forums

▸Draft and update HR policies, employee handbook, and standard operating procedures

Qualifications \& Experience

▸MBA in Human Resources (compulsory); full\-time MBA preferred; PGDM / MSW in HR may be considered

▸2–3 years of experience in a generalist HR role including recruitment; prior HR experience in the IT / software industry is an added advantage

▸Hands\-on experience with Indian payroll software (GreytHR, Keka, Zoho People, etc.)

▸Working knowledge of PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable labour laws

▸Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets for HR data management and reporting

▸Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi / Gujarati

Key Skills \& Competencies

Functional Skills

Behavioural Competencies

Payroll processing \& PF/ESI compliance

High ownership \& accountability

HRMS / payroll software proficiency

Discretion \& confidentiality

Labour law \& statutory compliance

Strong communication \& interpersonal skills

Recruitment \& talent acquisition

Attention to detail

Learning \& development facilitation

Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment

Performance management systems

Collaborative and team\-first mindset

What We Offer

▸A high\-impact role in a growing AI\-first EdTech company

▸Direct collaboration with the founding team and leadership

▸Opportunity to build HR processes from the ground up — make your mark

▸Supportive, learning\-oriented, and merit\-driven work culture

▸Flexible work environment with focus on outcomes over hours

▸Competitive compensation with performance\-linked growth

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Reference: 6893399  

  

We are excited to introduce a new role to support the continued growth of Tranzit Group and our five divisions: Coachlines, InterCity and Tourism (CIT), Tranzurban, Cross Country Rentals, Workshops and Fleet, and Group Shared Services.


This role provides end‑to‑end HR ownership for our Coachlines, InterCity and Tourism (CIT), and Workshops and Fleet divisions, delivering commercially grounded, high‑impact HR partnering. Reporting to the HR Manager, you will lead HR delivery for your divisions, working closely with a dedicated HR Coordinator to ensure consistent, high‑quality HR delivery.


If you are an experienced HR professional who thrives on building strong relationships, and providing clear, pragmatic advice — we'd love to hear from you!

**The role:**

* Provide dedicated HR partnering to your assigned divisions, delivering trusted, pragmatic advice across all generalist HR matters.
* End\-to\-end accountability for HR delivery across the full employment lifecycle.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage people\-related risks within your divisions, ensuring timely, well‑judged decisions aligned to organisational risk appetite and legal obligations.
* Lead and manage ER matters including investigations, disciplinaries, grievances and mediation, ensuring all processes are timely, fair and well documented.
* Support industrial relations activities, including collective bargaining and union engagement, ensuring compliance with employment legislation, collective agreements, and organisational policies.
* Partner with leaders on change initiatives, restructures and workforce planning.
* Coach and develop people leaders to build confidence, capability, and consistency in people management.
* Analyse people data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead and develop your HR Coordinator, building their capability and supporting effective HR delivery.

**We are looking for:**

* Strong commercial and risk acumen, with the ability to balance legal, operational, and organisational considerations to support decision\-making.
* Significant experience operating as a senior HR generalist or HRBP within a complex, multi‑site or multi‑divisional environment.
* Confidence navigating complex ER/IR issues with sound judgement and a calm, professional approach.
* A practical, solutions focused approach where you can influence and challenge constructively while keeping relationships strong.
* High resilience and the ability to manage competing priorities with strong judgement and autonomy.
* Able to travel as required nationwide to support your divisions.

**We offer:**

* Newly established opportunity within an experienced HR team.
* Competitive Remuneration \| Full time permanent role
* A fun and inclusive work environment; we're a proud NZ family\-owned organisation that just celebrated 100 years in business. Our journey keeps getting better!
* Location \- live and work locally in the Wairarapa while influencing at scale (and yes, we know how good that lifestyle is).
* Flexible working options and work perks, including discounts with our Tranzit Group of companies and industry partners.


Ready to make a impact? Apply today, we will be reviewing applications as they are received. **Applications close on 3 June 2026\.**

**All applicants must also have the legal entitlement to work in NZ.**

  

  

Applications Close: 03 Jun 2026

title: Area HR Partner Retail West
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


**Your mission**

**Reports to:** Senior Manager HR (Retail South \& West)


**Position Summary:** The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people\-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region.


**Key Objectives:**

* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
* Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people\-related decisions across stores.
* Assess behavioural and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
* Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
* Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
* Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on\-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
* Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
* Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
* Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

**Your talent**

**Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:**

* MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
* 2–4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer\-facing industries.
* Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

**Our principles**

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.
